limits: Two continuation known DEV cases with both methods using energy screening; no general superiority or optimum claim.
Timeout counters are last authenticated samples, not final totals or final observer-health proof.
Nested operation and setup timers must not be added without disjoint-scope justification.
Skipped immediate finishes are not equal to avoided source-router runs.

scopes.cleanup: Inclusive cleanup scope; contains sample, reap and cleanup sleep intervals. Do not add cleanup totals to phase totals.
scopes.clocks: Process CPU includes all threads; current-thread CPU is its subset. CPU clocks, wall intervals, and enclosing scopes are non-additive.
scopes.entry_to_end: Inclusive run setup, containment, cleanup, classification and forced final watchdog authentication; excludes final receipt serialization/publication.
scopes.overhead: Timer boundaries include some measurement overhead. Unattributed setup and final publication must not be inferred by summing phase totals.
scopes.reap: Includes regular, root-completion, exact-timeout and cleanup reaps.
scopes.sample: Includes periodic, root-completion and cleanup process samples.
scopes.sleep: Includes unchanged cheap-loop and cleanup sleeps; wall includes scheduler delay.
scopes.watchdog: Includes regular check calls and the forced final receipt authentication call; no watchdog policy or cadence changes.

terminal_energy_observation.cutoff_tail: No unfinished screen/guard operations at final source/resource closure
terminal_energy_observation.unobserved_tail_health: completed worker and final status authenticated
